extracted.intended_audience: Organizations, academic institutions, small businesses, and investigators preparing white papers or full proposals in response to ONR BAA N00014-22-S-B002 (contracts, grants, cooperative agreements, TIAs).
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit white papers or full proposals responsive to Office of Naval Research BAA N00014-22-S-B002, including required forms, technical/management content, compliance documentation, and subcontracting plans as applicable for contracts or grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Qualifications of PI and key personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualifications, capabilities, and experience of the proposed Principal Investigator (PI), team leader, and key personnel who are critical to achieving the proposal objectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess how the qualifications and experience of named personnel support achieving the objectives; emphasize critical personnel and their roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overall organizational structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Suitability of the organization for performing the proposed work and coherence of the organizational plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include academic/industrial partnership structure, royalty/licensing and other revenue generation methods, mechanisms and policies to ensure robust participation by small and medium-sized businesses and by large enterprises, and well-structured Intellectual Property management across contractual R&D arrangements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic and industrial partnership structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Academic and industrial partnership structure, with well-defined royalty, licensing, and other revenue generation methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe partnership roles, IP/revenue sharing approaches, and how partnerships strengthen execution and transition to practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Small and medium business participation mechanisms
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective mechanisms and policies to ensure robust participation by small and medium-sized businesses, and by large enterprises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain planned subcontracting, outreach, and policies to maximize small business participation consistent with efficient performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Intellectual Property management
rubrics_metrics.description: Well-structured and coherent Intellectual Property management across the range of contractual research and development arrangements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide IP management approach for prime/subawards, licensing, and technology transition considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential relevance to DoD
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential relevance to the Department of Defense (DoD) and contribution to a DoD component mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly describe future DoD relevance and how project outcomes contribute to the agency’s mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of funds and proposed cost share
rubrics_metrics.description: The availability of funds, to include proposed cost share in the project. (Not applicable to white papers.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include realistic budget and any proposed cost share; note that fund availability is part of full proposal evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation weighting for white papers and full proposals
rubrics_metrics.description: White papers: Criteria 1, 2, 3, and 4 are equally important. Full proposals: Criteria 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 are equally important.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use stated equal weighting to prioritize content in white papers vs full proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal evaluation and selection process
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR will review proposals as received but proposals will not be evaluated against each other since not submitted to a common work statement; selection recommendation is made by ONR scientific/technical community and forwarded for cost analysis and responsibility determination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A recommendation does not guarantee award; selection triggers contracting office steps (cost analysis, responsibility determination, funds availability).

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced cybersecurity compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: When applicable, certain offerors may be required to demonstrate compliance/the ability to comply with enhanced cybersecurity requirements prior to award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to Appendix 2, Section F, Federal Award Administration Information for specifics; be prepared to demonstrate cybersecurity compliance before award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to small business participation (contract awards only)
rubrics_metrics.description: ONR is strongly committed to providing meaningful prime and subcontracting opportunities for small businesses and socioeconomically disadvantaged entities through its awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Large businesses and non-profits must submit subcontracting plans; ONR will post small business contact information to facilitate connections (not an endorsement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subcontracting plan requirement for large businesses/non-profits
rubrics_metrics.description: For proposed contract awards exceeding $750,000, large businesses and non-profits shall provide a Subcontracting Plan containing all elements required by FAR 19.704, FAR 52.219-9, as supplemented by DFARS 252.219-7003.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Small businesses are exempt; the Plan must be attached to the Proposal Checklist (not included in page count). Master/Individual/Comprehensive Plans are acceptable if submitted. Plans are reviewed for adequacy; failure to negotiate an acceptable Plan when required makes the offeror ineligible for award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subcontracting plan goals and justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Offerors shall propose realistic goals to ensure small business participation consistent with efficient performance and aligned with current DoD small business subcontracting goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If proposed goals are below statutory requirements, include a viable written explanation of why small businesses cannot be utilized and what attempts were made.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subcontracting resources and outreach
rubrics_metrics.description: Lists of potential resources to assist in locating subcontracting partners (e.g., DAU SB COP, Dynamic Small Business Search, eSRS, SAM.gov, SBA SubNet).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use listed resources to find subcontracting opportunities; follow FAR 5.206 for posting notices to GPE when seeking subcontract competition.

rubrics_metrics.name: GPE notice content for subcontract opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices to the Government-wide Point of Entry (GPE) must describe the business opportunity, any prequalification requirements, and where to obtain technical data needed to respond.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicable for primes/subcontractors under certain thresholds per FAR; ensure notices include required elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation of contract/grant options
rubrics_metrics.description: The Government will evaluate options for award purposes by adding the total cost for all options to the total cost for the basic requirement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation of options does not obligate the Government to exercise them; the Government reserves the right to exercise options at award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evaluation panel and confidentiality
rubrics_metrics.description: White papers, technical and cost proposals will be protected from unauthorized disclosure per FAR. The cognizant Program Officer and Government scientific experts perform evaluations; support contractors may be used as subject-matter-experts but selection and award decisions are Government personnel responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support contractor employees with access must sign ONR NDA for Contractor Support (includes third-party beneficiary language).

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal award notices and pre-award information requests
rubrics_metrics.description: All applicants will receive a notification email advising selection status; applicants recommended for award may be contacted for additional information (representations and certifications, revised budgets, certificate of current cost or pricing data, subcontracting plan, and/or other information).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notification e-mail is not authorization to commit funds; only a signed award document by a Contracting Officer or Grants Officer authorizes work to begin.

rubrics_metrics.name: Export control compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Offerors must ensure compliance with all U.S. export control laws and regulations, including ITAR (22 CFR Parts 120-130) and EAR (15 CFR Parts 730-774), and address in proposals whether ITAR or EAR restrictions apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offerors are responsible for obtaining required licenses or approvals (including deemed exports) and should reference ITAR/EAR and Export Control Reform Initiative materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security classification and classified access
rubrics_metrics.description: If access to classified material will be required during performance, the Offeror must identify such need in the Proposal Checklist; a DD Form 254 will be attached to the award and FAR 52.204-2 will be incorporated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ONR does not provide access to classified material under grants or cooperative agreements; follow instructions to request classified access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for research involving animals
rubrics_metrics.description: If animals are to be used, Offeror must submit a Full Appendix or Abbreviated Appendix with supporting documentation (e.g., IACUC approval, approved protocol, most recent USDA inspection report) prior to award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comply with DoD Instruction 3216.01 and implementing guidance; contact ONR Animal Use Administrator for assistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for research involving human subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Offerors must protect rights and welfare of human subjects and comply with the Common Rule at 32 CFR part 219 and applicable DoD/DON instructions and FDA/state law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prior to award submit IRB approval and related documentation, human research training proof, and DHHS-issued FWA; submit any claimed exemptions with rationale and institutional sign-off. Documentation is submitted to ONR HRPO via Program Officer; HRPO has final judgment. Research involving human subjects must not commence until HRPO approval is included in the award; Government will not reimburse work done in violation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosafety and biosecurity compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Offerors must comply with applicable provisions of DODM 6055.18 and meet minimum applicable requirements of CDC BMBL and NIH Guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure laboratory biosafety standards and NIH/rDNA guidance are followed for relevant work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for rDNA and synthetic nucleic acid research
rubrics_metrics.description: Offerors must not begin rDNA research until ONR has reviewed and accepted documentation, including a written institutional statement of compliance with NIH Guidelines and evidence of IBC approval and DHHS letter of approval or compliance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide documentation as part of the original proposal prior to award to enable ONR review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Dual Use Research of Concern (DURC)
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutions must comply with the United States Government Policy for Institutional Oversight of Life Sciences Dual Use Research of Concern; contact the cognizant Technical Point of Contact if research involves certain biological agents or toxins.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow S3 guidance and institutional oversight requirements for DURC.

rubrics_metrics.name: DoD High Performance Computing Program eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Awardees of ONR contracts, grants, and other instruments may be eligible to use DoD HPCMP assets with Program Officer approval and completion of security/screening requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See HPCMP application procedures and obtain Program Officer approval when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project and program review meetings expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Review Meetings typically last ~1 day (about 2 in-person per year) and Program Review Meetings typically last 2-3 days (generally once per year); meetings may be virtual or in-person and sometimes held at performer facilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For cost estimating, assume specified virtual/in-person mix; include hosting-language if offering facilities (optional and will not affect selection).

rubrics_metrics.name: Full proposal format and file requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Full proposals must follow mandatory forms and additional instructions: single-spaced, Times New Roman >=12 point, discuss page limits with Program Officer, no page limits for budget, and electronic file names must not exceed 68 characters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach files as PDF without macros or password protection; non-compliant attachments will be rejected by automated acceptance checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory SF-424 (R&R) and specific field completion
rubrics_metrics.description: Use SF-424 (R&R) as the cover page and complete required fields per instructions; special instructions provided for Fields 3, 4a, 4b, 4c, 5, 7, 11, 14, 16, 17, and 19.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete SF-424 first (it auto-populates other forms); failure to provide Program Officer Code may result in rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project summary/abstract requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Project summary/abstract must identify the research problem and objectives, technical approaches, anticipated outcome, and impact on DoD capabilities; use only standard QWERTY characters, spell out non-English letters/symbols; graphics are not allowed; limit 1 page or 4,000 characters (whichever is less).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include proprietary or confidential information; mark the abstract 'Approved for Public Release' because abstracts of funded projects will be posted on DTIC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research and Related Other Project Information (Field 8) content requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Project Narrative (technical proposal) must be attached as a single PDF and should include: Cover Page (BAA number, title, prime identity and subawards, technical and administrative contacts, proposed period), Table of Contents, Technical Approach, Future DoD Relevance, Project Schedule and Milestones, and Reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Technical Approach should describe scientific/technical concepts, complete research plan, innovation, comparison to alternate approaches, and anticipated results/new knowledge. Include sample reports (technical & financial progress reports, final report). Note: Grants do not include delivery of software, prototypes, or hardware deliverables.

rubrics_metrics.name: Management approach and PI qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe overall management approach, rationale for participation of key team members, planned relationships with subawardees or collaborators, single PI structure fit, anticipated schedule (if appropriate), and Principal Investigator qualifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how management and personnel support successful execution under a single-PI award and include evidence of PI and key personnel qualifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offeror responsibility information
rubrics_metrics.description: Offerors must describe adequate resources or the ability to obtain resources required to complete the activities and describe the ability to comply with grant conditions given existing and prospective commitments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide information that assists ONR in evaluating the offeror's responsibility to perform the award.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and question submission protocol
rubrics_metrics.description: All UNCLASSIFIED communications shall be submitted via e-mail to the Technical Point of Contact with a copy to the designated Business POC; CLASSIFIED questions must be handled through the ONR Security POC using the specified procedure; comments should be concise and reference the relevant BAA part and paragraph.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not email classified questions; follow the described process to arrange secure classified communication.
